en: I arranged my house yesterday.

ar: رتبتي المكتب ديالك قبل ما تمشي
en: You arranged your desk before you left.

lat: ma rettebtish l-hwayej dyalek f l-khzana

lat: ma katrettbush l-kuzina mn ba3d l-ghda

en: You don't arrange the kitchen after lunch.

ar: غادي ترتب الحانوت مع خوك غدا
en: You're going to arrange the shop with your brother tomorrow.

ar: غادي ترتبي الهدايا مع ماما غدا
en: You're going to arrange the gifts with Mom tomorrow.

ar: ما غاديش ترتب المكتب ديالها غدا
en: She's not going to arrange her desk tomorrow.

lat: ghadi nrettbu l-7efla dyalna f d-dar
en: We're going to arrange our party at home.

lat: ma ghadish nrettbu l-bit bla mama
ar: ما غاديش نرتبو البيت بلا ماما
en: We're not going to arrange the house without Mom.

lat: ma ghadish trettbu d-dulab dyalkum l-yum
ar: ما غاديش ترتبو الدولاب ديالكم اليوم
en: You're not going to arrange your cupboard today.

lat: ma ghadish yrettbu l-bit dyalhum ghedda
ar: ما غاديش يرتبو البيت ديالهم غدا
en: They're not going to arrange their house tomorrow.
